title: Spreading a generic fibre component to a clopen piece
statement: Let $g:P\to T$ be a finite type morphism of schemes (locally of finite type and quasi-compact, as in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]). Let $y\in T$ and $x\in P$ satisfy $g(x)=y$. There exist an ambient open $V\subseteq T$ with $y\in V$ and a subset $A\subseteq P$ whose trace on $g^{-1}(V\cap\overline{\{y\}})$ is clopen for the subspace topology, and such that $g^{-1}(\{y\})\cap A$ is exactly the connected component of $x$ in the fibre $g^{-1}(\{y\})$. No assertion is made about connectedness of fibres over points other than $y$.

source.place: Tag 055N, integral-base proof through clopenness of the closure; Tags 054Y and 054W

proof.text: The scheme-theoretic fibre is locally noetherian by LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and is compact by quasi-compactness of g. Thus it is noetherian. Transport NoetherianSpace to the set-theoretic fibre by g.fiberHomeo. WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Topology.NoetherianSpace supplies local connectedness, so the connected component S of x in that fibre is clopen.

Set C = closure(Subtype.val image S) and D = closure(Subtype.val image Sᶜ) in P. Since S and its complement are closed in the fibre, IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.closure_eq_preimage_closure_image identifies their traces with S and Sᶜ. Consequently C and D cover the fibre and their intersection has empty fibre.
Use the closed-cover spreading theorem to get V₁ over which C and D cover the inverse image of closure({y}). Use closed avoidance for C ∩ D to get V₂ over which they are disjoint.

Take V = V₁ ∩ V₂ and A = C. The traces of C and D on g⁻¹(V ∩ closure({y})) are closed and complementary, hence clopen. The fibre trace of C is S under the subtype inclusion. connectedComponentIn_eq_image then gives exactly g⁻¹({y}) ∩ A = connectedComponentIn(g⁻¹({y})) x.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_generic_fibre_component_spread {P T : Scheme.{u}} (g : P ⟶ T)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] (y : T) (x : P) (hx : g x = y) :
    ∃ (V : Set T) (A : Set P), IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧
      IsClopen {q : g ⁻¹' (V ∩ closure {y}) | (q : P) ∈ A} ∧
      g ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A = connectedComponentIn (g ⁻¹' {y}) x
